title: Staff Software Engineer - BackEnd (Level 4) | Gurugram, IND
description:
**About Agoda**



At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

  




Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

  



No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

  


**About our Team**  

At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds **high\-scale, fault\-tolerant distributed systems** that power a global travel platform serving **millions of users daily**. We own mission\-critical domains across **inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms**.



Our systems run with **high availability, low latency, and zero\-downtime expectations**, powered by modern technologies such as **Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike**, along with strong foundations in **CI/CD, automation, and observability**.



We ship fast—often **dozens of releases a day**—and design systems that are **resilient, self\-healing, and built to scale globally**.

  

**The Opportunity**  

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end\-to\-end — from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade\-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands\-on coding, system design, and technical ownership — accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams.

  

**What You will Do**

  


* Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
* Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end\-to\-end, within your service or team
* Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
* Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
* Optimize high\-throughput, low\-latency systems
* Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
* Make independent architectural and technical trade\-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
* Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team
* Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context
* Stay hands\-on with coding and system design
* Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
* Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow\-through improvements

  

**What We're Looking For**


*Technical*

  


* 8–12 years of backend engineering experience
* Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
* Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs \& system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
* Strong coding and problem\-solving ability


*Beyond the technical bar:*

  


* A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks — initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
* Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
* Experience communicating trade\-offs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
* Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help

  



Nice to Have

  


* Experience building large\-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
* Exposure to event\-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)
* Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

  


###### **\#Delhi \#Gurgaon \#Gurugram \#Bangalore \#Bengaluru \#Chennai \#Noida \#DelhiNCR \#Pune \#Mumbai \#Hyderabad \#Chandigarh \#Kolkata**

#### 


#### **Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click** **here****to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.**

  


### **Discover more about working at Agoda**


* Agoda Careers https://careersatagoda.com
* Facebook https://www.facebook.com/agodacareers/
* LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/agoda
* YouTube https://www.youtube.com/agodalife

  


**Equal Opportunity Employer**



At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.



We will keep your application on file so that we can consider you for future vacancies and you can always ask to have your details removed from the file. For more details please read our privacy policy.

title: Senior Python Backend Data Engineer Experience: 5+ Years
description:
We are seeking a Senior Python Backend Data Engineer with strong experience in Python\-based backend development, data engineering, API development, and AWS cloud services. The developer will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable backend services, data pipelines, integrations, and data processing workflows supporting data\-driven applications.  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and data processing solutions using Python.
* Develop RESTful APIs and backend services using frameworks such as FastAPI.
* Design and implement ETL/ELT pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and processing of data from multiple sources.
* Work with AWS services such as Lambda, Glue, S3, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, and CloudWatch.
* Integrate data from APIs, databases, file systems, and other enterprise sources.
* Design efficient data models and work with SQL and NoSQL databases such as MongoDB.
* Implement data validation, quality checks, error handling, logging, and monitoring.
* Optimize backend services and data pipelines for performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Collaborate closely with frontend, DevOps, QA, and other engineering teams to enable end\-to\-end feature delivery.
* Troubleshoot production issues and support ongoing enhancements and maintenance.
* Follow secure coding, version control, CI/CD, and Agile development practices.

**Required Skill Set:**

* 5\+ years of experience in Python backend and/or data engineering.
* Strong proficiency in Python and backend development.
* Hands\-on experience with FastAPI or similar Python frameworks.
* Strong experience developing RESTful APIs and backend integrations.
* Experience with AWS services including Lambda, Glue, S3, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, and CloudWatch.
* Strong understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines and data processing.
* Good knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases, preferably MongoDB.
* Experience with data modeling, schema design, and large\-scale data processing.
* Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong understanding of application security, authentication, and access control.
* Experience troubleshooting and optimizing backend/data\-intensive applications.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.

* **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The Team**



Deloitte’s Technology \& Transformation practice can help you uncover and unlock the value buried deep inside vast amounts of data. Our global network provides strategic guidance and implementation services to help companies manage data from disparate sources and convert them into accurate, actionable information that supports fact\-driven decision\-making and digital transformation. Our practice spans cloud, application modernization, enterprise integration, analytics, engineering, and next\-generation technologies across industries including Energy, Utilities, Manufacturing, and Industrial Automation.

  


**Your Work Profile**

  



Senior Java Developer with strong expertise in **Core/Advanced Java**, **Spring Boot microservices**, and **event\-driven messaging (Solace PubSub\+)**. You’ll design, build, deploy, and operate high\-throughput, resilient services in a regulated financial services environment.

  


* Design and develop scalable microservices using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and Spring Cloud Stream
* Build and maintain event\-driven messaging pipelines using Solace PubSub\+ (topics, queues, guaranteed delivery, replay)
* Implement and own RESTful APIs; contribute to API design standards and documentation
* Apply secure coding practices across the SDLC (OWASP Top 10, input validation, secrets management, least privilege)
* Write high\-quality, testable code with strong unit/integration coverage (JUnit 5, Mockito, Cucumber/BDD)
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Git/GitHub, Jenkins, and Ansible
* Use developer productivity tooling effectively (including Copilot)
* Package and deploy services using Docker and Kubernetes
* Operate and monitor production services using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki and related observability tooling
* Work with PostgreSQL (schema contributions, query optimisation, migrations via Flyway/Liquibase)
* Participate in code reviews and incident response; drive continuous improvement

  


**Required skills \& experience**

  


* Education\- BE/BTech/MCA
* Experience: 7\+ years Java development; 4\+ years running Spring Boot microservices in production
* Java: Java 11/17/21, concurrency, memory model; clean code, SOLID, design patterns; performance profiling (heap/thread dumps)
* Spring: Spring Boot, MVC, Data JPA, Security; Spring Cloud (Config, Gateway, Eureka/Consul, Resilience4j); Stream/Function
* APIs: REST principles, versioning; OpenAPI/Swagger; API security (OAuth2, JWT)
* Security: OWASP awareness; dependency vulnerability management; secrets management (Vault/Jasypt or equivalent)
* Testing: BDD with Cucumber (Gherkin, step definitions, runners); integration with Spring test context
* Messaging: Solace topics/queues, durable subscriptions, replay; error handling (DLQ/error queues, ACK modes)
* DevOps: Git workflows/PRs; Jenkins pipeline\-as\-code; Ansible playbooks; Docker best practices; Kubernetes deployments and probes
* Observability: dashboards/alerts (Grafana), metrics (Prometheus/PromQL), logs (Loki/LogQL); tracing (Zipkin/Sleuth/OpenTelemetry)

  


**Location and Way of Working**


* Pune (Hybrid)
* Comfortable in Agile/Scrum teams
* Strong communicator—able to explain technical trade\-offs to engineers and business stakeholders
* Proactive, security\-conscious mindset and ownership through delivery and production support

title: Senior Software Engineer – Java Backend
description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Software Engineer – Java Backend with strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, cloud technologies, and distributed systems. The ideal candidate will have experience building scalable applications, managing production environments, and working with modern DevOps and cloud\-native technologies.

**Key Responsibilities**

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Java 11/17\+, Spring Boot, and Microservices.

Develop secure, high\-performance REST APIs and system integrations.

Design and implement event\-driven solutions using Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging platforms.

Develop and optimize solutions using SQL and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, and Redis.

Collaborate with architects and cross\-functional teams to deliver resilient, cloud\-native applications.

Implement automated testing, code quality, and CI/CD practices.

Deploy and manage applications using Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, and Helm.

Work with public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Manage production releases, deployment planning, validation, rollback strategies, and change management.

Participate in on\-call rotations and provide support for critical production systems.

Lead troubleshooting and resolution of major production incidents while ensuring SLA compliance.

Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and post\-incident reviews and implement preventive measures.

Monitor application health and performance using tools such as Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, ELK, or AppDynamics.

Optimize applications for scalability, performance, availability, and security.

Conduct code reviews and mentor junior developers.

Contribute to technical documentation, operational runbooks, architecture reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Must\-Have Skills**

8\+ years of Java backend development experience.

Strong expertise in:

Java , JRE / JDK ,Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, Microservices, System Design

Strong experience with:

AWS and/or Azure, Kafka / RabbitMQ, REST APIs, Docker, Kubernetes / OpenShift, Helm

Strong knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases.

Strong experience with PostgreSQL.

Good understanding of distributed systems.

Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms.

Experience managing production deployments and critical incidents.

Experience with on\-call support and production troubleshooting.

Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and observability tools.

Strong understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, and Agile methodologies.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

**Additional Requirements**

Strong communication skills are essential.

Candidates should preferably have demonstrated employment stability, with at least 2 years in previous organizations.

Candidates available to join immediately to 45 days are preferred.

Experience in a client\-facing environment is highly desirable.

Only qualified candidates will be contacted.
